title: Official recapitulation sheets for the 2002 general election, county totals
authoritative: Source: the county election commissioners' official recapitulation sheets filed with the Secretary of State; county totals add up to each candidate's state total.

pages.hint: A rotated, handwritten county recapitulation sheet. Header has exactly one entry: the county name written after 'in the County of'. Each row is a printed candidate line, and its values has one string: the handwritten number in the rightmost Totals column. Ignore every precinct column and skip office heading lines.
